paragraphs.text: One-click full frontend reload button in the DSH conversation session header.
# dsh-ui-reload
A "reload the whole frontend" button in the DSH conversation session header, immediately left of the
whole frontend" button in the DSH conversation session header, immediately left of the share button.
Clicking it reloads the entire page — the one operation that reliably picks up anything the frontend
can be out of sync with: client plugin bundles rebuilt under the running page, plugin-list changes,
stale CSS, and the shell's own code.
## Requirements

| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Mode
| Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) — there is no CLI surface |
Earlier DSH releases are untested. The button mounts into the slot `conversation.session.header.util
ities`; a release that renames or removes that slot leaves it unrendered.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row is appended to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loa
der mounts it on the next start. Reload the page once after installing — the client half is served a
s a separate module.
Manual install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why a full reload and not HMR
DSH already ships `dsh-client-hmr`, which republishes a plugin the moment its bundle changes. This b
utton exists for the residue that path cannot reach — a page whose shell or bootstrap predates a cha
nge, or state that only a real document load clears. Reloading the document is the only thing that c
at only a real document load clears. Reloading the document is the only thing that covers all of it.
**What survives a click:** conversation, workspace and connection state — they live on the host.
**What does not:** anything held only in the page — scroll position, open panels, in-flight composer
text, running client-side timers.
## How it works
The package has two halves and the bundle patch mounts both:
- `lib/index.js` — the host half. It exports an empty `apply()` and registers no route, service or w
atcher, because a plain page reload needs nothing from the host. It exists only so the bundle row ha
s something to mount; dropping it would stop the package from being composed at all, taking the clie

nt button with it.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, injected through `dsh.client.inject: ["@dee
pseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots"]`. It registers the button into `conversation.session.header.utilities
` and calls `window.location.reload()` on click, after a 400 ms acknowledgement so the click registe
rs visually before the load takes over.
## Companion plugins

- `dsh-session-tree` — sidebar with tags, grouping and drag-to-move.
- `dsh-session-manager` — agent

tools and REST API for session housekeeping.
- `dsh-session-search` — in-conversation find bar.
- `
dsh-session-query-vector` — semantic session search backend.
